args: Apparel: never-redeemed vs ever-redeemed members vs non-members, by tenure

Once we separate loyalty members into those who have actually redeemed a point at least once versus those who never have, do the engaged ones match or beat non-members of similar tenure, while the disengaged majority lags behind?
